# Pesher Habakkuk Column 13 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** 1QpHab (Cave 1), Col. 13 | **Condition:** Final column; well preserved with minor damage at bottom

---

**13:1** "Woe to him who causes his neighbor to drink,

**13:2** pouring out his fury, and also making him drunk,

**13:3** to gaze on their festivals!" (Hab 2:15)

**13:4** Its interpretation concerns the Wicked Priest,

**13:5** who pursued the Teacher of Righteousness

**13:6** to swallow him up in the fury of

**13:7** his anger, at his place of exile.

**13:8** And at the time of the festival of rest, [...]

**13:9** "You are filled with shame instead of glory.

**13:10** Drink also yourself and stagger!

**13:11** The cup of the LORD's right hand

**13:12** will come around to you, and disgrace upon your glory" (Hab 2:16).

**13:13** Its interpretation concerns the priest whose shame

**13:14** exceeded his glory, because he did not circumcise

**13:15** the foreskin of his heart, and he walked

**13:16** in ways of drunkenness to quench his thirst.

**13:17** But the cup of the wrath of God will swallow him up, adding to [...] his shame, and the pain [...]

---
*LOGOS notes: Column 13 covers Hab 2:15-17, 18-20. This translation maintains formal equivalence while rendering readable English. The pesher (interpretation) sections apply Habakkuk's prophecy to the Qumran community's historical situation. Key figures: Teacher of Righteousness, Wicked Priest, Man of the Lie, the Kittim (Romans). "Interpretation" used consistently for pesher. Lacunae [...] indicate physical manuscript damage.*
